public_rationale: The dated B200 benchmark rose over the reported three-month interval. That challenges the forecast's direction so far within this segment, but it neither measures the whole rental market nor rules out a later fall. No decisive event establishes the predicted aggregate decline and supply mechanism. Because Zitron supplied no deadline, the forecast remains open.
limitations: One GPU model's benchmark cannot represent the aggregate market.
A forecast without a deadline cannot be marked failed solely because prices have not fallen by the evaluation date.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI compute may not be profitable, and GPU rental prices will fall because so much has been spent on the same GPUs.

statement.excerpt: On top of that, AI compute itself may not be profitable, and because, by my estimate, everybody has spent about $85 billion on filling data centers with the same GPUs, the aggregate price of renting out GPUs will decline.

from_speaker: AI compute itself may not be profitable
filling data centers with the same GPUs
the aggregate price of renting out GPUs will decline
our_interpretation: The firm forecast is a decline in aggregate GPU rental prices after publication. The profitability clause is hedged, and the spending estimate is the proposed explanation rather than a separate price outcome.
Use comparable per-GPU-hour rental prices with stable treatment of GPU generations, geography and contract terms.
Aggregate means a representative rental market measure, not an isolated provider discount or movement in one GPU generation.
The forecast gives no deadline. The evaluation date is not an implied deadline.
The claimed mechanism requires evidence that added competing capacity contributed to the decline; spending alone does not establish delivered supply.
criteria.support_condition: A representative, comparable post-publication rental-price series establishes a broad decline from the publication baseline, with evidence that added competing GPU capacity contributed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence conclusively disproves the asserted causal mechanism or makes the forecast impossible. A finite period of rising or unchanged prices cannot alone falsify an eventual decline without a deadline.
